senses.en: One or the other of two; each of two sides.
One or the other of two people or things.
Also not, used after a negative statement.

ex.en: You can borrow either umbrella; both are dry.
Students can choose either vocational training or university education, depending on their interests and career goals.

col: either side｜một trong hai bên; mỗi bên
either of them｜một trong hai người/vật đó
tip: either ... or ... là cấu trúc chọn một trong hai; either ở cuối câu phủ định nghĩa là “cũng không”.

senses.en: A place where people stay temporarily, often in tents.
Stay outdoors temporarily in a tent or similar shelter.
A group sharing the same opinions or aims.

ex.en: We returned to camp before the rain started.
Schools can organise outdoor camps to help students develop independence and learn practical skills beyond the classroom.

tip: go camping nghĩa là đi cắm trại; camp cũng có thể chỉ phe có cùng quan điểm.

senses.en: Quickly and unexpectedly, with little or no warning.

ex.en: The lights suddenly went out while we were cooking.
When demand suddenly increases, public transport systems may struggle to provide enough services for passengers.

tip: Có thể đặt đầu câu hoặc trước động từ; nhấn mạnh sự thay đổi bất ngờ, không báo trước.

senses.en: A substance that spreads freely to fill its container.
Gas used as fuel for heating or cooking.
Petrol used to power vehicles, in American English.

ex.en: We use gas to cook our meals at home.
Reducing greenhouse gas emissions requires investment in cleaner energy and more efficient public transport systems.

col: a gas leak｜rò rỉ khí gas
tip: Chỉ chung chất khí thì thường không đếm được; nhiều loại khí dùng gases.

senses.en: A tool with two blades for cutting things.

ex.en: Please use these scissors to cut the wrapping paper.
Teachers should supervise young children when they use scissors during classroom craft activities.

col: a pair of scissors｜một chiếc kéo
tip: Thường dùng ở số nhiều; một chiếc kéo nói a pair of scissors.

senses.en: A small ornamental fish, often orange, kept in ponds or tanks.

ex.en: Our goldfish swims between the plants in its large tank.
Keeping goldfish in suitably sized tanks can teach children responsibility and the importance of animal welfare.

col: feed the goldfish｜cho cá vàng ăn
tip: goldfish có số ít và số nhiều giống nhau: one goldfish, two goldfish.

senses.en: the rear part of an animal or an aircraft
to follow someone closely and watch where they go

ex.en: The dog wagged its tail when I came home.
Some animals use their tails for balance, which helps them move safely through complex forest habitats.

tip: tail là cái đuôi; tale là câu chuyện; hai từ đồng âm.

senses.en: Belonging to a particular person, rather than someone else.
To have something that legally belongs to you.

ex.en: I finally have my own room in our new flat.
People who own their homes may feel more financially secure, although maintenance costs can be substantial.

col: my own room｜phòng riêng của tôi
own a home｜sở hữu một ngôi nhà
on your own｜một mình; tự lập
tip: own với nghĩa “của riêng” thường đứng sau từ sở hữu như my own.

senses.en: To mark a special occasion by doing something enjoyable.
To praise someone or something publicly.

ex.en: We cooked a special dinner to celebrate her graduation.
Community festivals celebrate local traditions while giving residents opportunities to strengthen relationships with their neighbours.

col: celebrate a birthday｜ăn mừng sinh nhật
celebrate an achievement｜ăn mừng một thành tựu
celebrate diversity｜tôn vinh sự đa dạng
tip: Ăn mừng điều gì dùng celebrate; chúc mừng ai dùng congratulate.

senses.en: made of wood
showing little natural feeling or movement

ex.en: She stirred the soup slowly with a wooden spoon.
Wooden buildings can offer environmental benefits when their materials come from responsibly managed forests.

col: wooden furniture｜đồ nội thất bằng gỗ
wooden performance｜màn trình diễn cứng nhắc
tip: wooden là làm bằng gỗ; woody thường chỉ tính chất của gỗ hoặc giống gỗ.

senses.en: needed for a particular purpose or situation

ex.en: Take a warm coat if you think it's necessary.
Investment in public transport is necessary to reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.

col: necessary precautions｜các biện pháp phòng ngừa cần thiết
tip: Thường dùng it is necessary to do; necessarily nghĩa là “tất yếu”.

senses.en: To offer an idea or possible action for consideration.
To indicate that something may be true.

ex.en: I suggest taking an umbrella because those clouds look dark.
Recent studies suggest that access to green spaces can improve mental health among urban residents.

col: suggest a solution｜đề xuất một giải pháp
suggest doing something｜đề nghị làm việc gì
evidence suggests that｜bằng chứng cho thấy rằng
tip: Dùng suggest doing hoặc suggest that + mệnh đề, không dùng suggest to do.

senses.zh: điều hòa không khí; hệ thống điều hòa
senses.en: A system that cools indoor air and controls humidity.

ex.en: Please turn on the air-conditioning before the guests arrive.
Greater reliance on air-conditioning during heatwaves can place considerable pressure on urban electricity supplies.

col: turn on the air-conditioning｜bật điều hòa
tip: Không đếm được; một chiếc máy điều hòa là an air conditioner.

senses.en: Untidy or dirty, with things scattered or out of place.
Complicated and difficult to deal with.

ex.en: His desk was messy after an afternoon of painting.
Without clear responsibilities, cooperation between public agencies can become messy and delay the delivery of essential services.

tip: messy có thể chỉ đồ đạc lộn xộn, cũng có thể chỉ tình huống phức tạp khó xử lý.

senses.en: Not long ago, or during the period just before now.

ex.en: We recently moved into a flat near the river.
Researchers have recently explored how access to green spaces influences the mental health of urban residents.

col: recently published｜mới được xuất bản gần đây
tip: Có thể dùng với quá khứ đơn hoặc hiện tại hoàn thành, không chỉ hiện tại hoàn thành.

senses.en: mainly, or for the largest part

ex.en: My weekend was mostly spent cooking and reading.
In many rural areas, residents rely mostly on private vehicles because public transport services are limited.

col: mostly sunny｜phần lớn thời gian nắng
mostly made of｜chủ yếu làm bằng
tip: mostly chỉ phần lớn trường hợp; almost chỉ “suýt” hoặc “gần như”.

senses.zh: thuộc âm nhạc; có năng khiếu âm nhạc
senses.en: Relating to music, or showing skill and interest in it.
A play or film whose story includes songs and dancing.
Having a pleasant sound resembling music.

ex.en: He keeps his musical instruments beside the sofa.
Schools that offer musical training give children valuable opportunities to develop creativity and practise teamwork.

col: musical performance｜buổi biểu diễn âm nhạc
a stage musical｜một vở nhạc kịch sân khấu
tip: Là tính từ nghĩa là “thuộc âm nhạc”; là danh từ đếm được nghĩa là nhạc kịch.

senses.en: to move quickly back and forth, or cause this movement

senses.zh: làm chấn động; làm lung lay
senses.en: to upset someone deeply or weaken their confidence
a quick movement back and forth

ex.en: Shake the bottle well before pouring juice into your glass.
Repeated failures in public transport can shake commuters' confidence in the reliability of urban services.

col: shake with fear｜run lên vì sợ
shake confidence｜làm lung lay niềm tin
tip: Động từ bất quy tắc: shake – shook – shaken.

senses.en: a unit of volume equal to one thousand millilitres

ex.en: We need a litre of milk for this pudding.
Measuring household water use in litres can help residents understand consumption and identify opportunities to reduce waste.

col: a litre of milk｜một lít sữa
tip: Anh Anh viết litre, Anh Mỹ viết liter; số nhiều thêm s.

senses.en: An act of cutting hair, or the resulting hairstyle.

ex.en: I need a haircut before my cousin's wedding.
Offering affordable haircuts at community centres can help trainee hairdressers gain practical experience while serving local residents.

tip: Nói get hoặc have a haircut, không nói cut a haircut.

senses.en: to believe that something will probably happen
to regard something as necessary or reasonably required
to believe someone or something will arrive soon

ex.en: We expect rain, so take an umbrella with you.
Employers increasingly expect graduates to demonstrate practical skills as well as a strong understanding of their subject.

col: expect to do something｜dự kiến làm việc gì
expect someone to do something｜mong ai làm việc gì
fully expect｜hoàn toàn dự đoán được
tip: expect thiên về việc cho rằng sẽ xảy ra; hope thiên về việc mong muốn xảy ra.

senses.en: a tropical fruit with rough skin and sweet yellow flesh

ex.en: She sliced a fresh pineapple for our picnic.
Growing pineapple for export can support rural incomes, but intensive farming may damage local soils.

tip: Cả quả dứa đếm được; phần thịt quả dùng làm đồ ăn thường không đếm được.

senses.en: One of the hard parts forming a body's supporting frame.
To remove the bones from meat or fish.

ex.en: He broke a bone in his wrist while skating.
Regular weight-bearing exercise helps maintain bone strength and can reduce the risk of fractures in older adults.

tip: Khi là động từ, bone nghĩa là lọc xương; boneless nghĩa là không xương.

senses.en: A smooth surface, usually glass, that shows a reflected image.
Show the same qualities, changes, or features as something else.

ex.en: He checked his hair in the mirror before leaving.
Changes in consumer spending often mirror broader economic trends, particularly during periods of financial uncertainty.

col: a full-length mirror｜gương soi toàn thân
mirror changes｜phản ánh những thay đổi
tip: Soi gương dùng look in the mirror, không dùng look the mirror.

senses.en: A small, simple building, often made of wood or grass.

ex.en: We sheltered from the rain in a wooden hut.
Mountain huts provide essential shelter for hikers, but their construction should minimise damage to fragile ecosystems.

tip: hut nhấn mạnh sự nhỏ và đơn sơ, thường không phải nhà ở đầy đủ tiện nghi.

senses.en: Having a sharp taste like a lemon.
Having an unpleasant taste or smell after becoming spoiled.

senses.zh: trở nên tồi tệ; làm xấu đi
senses.en: To become less pleasant or make a relationship worse.

ex.en: These grapes are too sour for my taste.
Disagreements over shared resources can sour relations between neighbouring countries and delay important environmental projects.

tip: go sour có thể chỉ thức ăn hỏng, cũng có thể chỉ quan hệ trở nên tệ.

senses.en: The money used in a particular country.

senses.zh: sự lưu hành; sự phổ biến
senses.en: The state of being widely accepted or used.

ex.en: We exchanged our money for local currency at the airport.
A weaker currency can attract international tourists by making accommodation and other services more affordable.

tip: Một loại tiền cụ thể thì đếm được; tiền tệ nói chung thường không đếm được.

senses.en: An official award showing successful completion of education or training.

senses.zh: trình độ; điều kiện đủ tư cách
senses.en: A skill or quality making someone suitable for a role.

senses.zh: điều kiện hạn chế; sự bảo lưu
senses.en: A condition that limits the meaning or acceptance of something.

ex.en: This qualification helped me find work at a nursery.
Employers increasingly value practical experience alongside formal qualifications when recruiting graduates for demanding professional roles.

tip: Khi nói về bằng cấp hoặc trình độ thường dùng số nhiều qualifications.

senses.zh: vấn đề; chủ đề quan trọng
senses.en: An important subject or problem that needs discussion.
To officially announce or give something to people.
One edition of a regularly published newspaper or magazine.

ex.en: We discussed the parking issue at our neighbourhood meeting.
Governments must address the issue of housing affordability to ensure that young adults can live independently.

col: address an issue｜giải quyết một vấn đề
a controversial issue｜một vấn đề gây tranh cãi
issue a warning｜đưa ra cảnh báo
tip: issue với nghĩa “vấn đề” thường chỉ chủ đề cần thảo luận, không nhất thiết là khó khăn.

senses.en: Inside a building, or into a building.

ex.en: We stayed indoors and played chess during the storm.
Children who spend most of their time indoors may have fewer opportunities for physical activity.

col: keep pets indoors｜nuôi thú cưng trong nhà
tip: indoors là trạng từ; để bổ nghĩa cho danh từ dùng indoor, như indoor sports.

senses.zh: làm kinh ngạc; làm sửng sốt
senses.en: to surprise someone very much

ex.en: The magician's clever tricks never fail to amaze the children.
Advances in medical technology continue to amaze researchers and offer new hope to patients with complex conditions.

col: never cease to amaze｜luôn khiến người ta kinh ngạc
amaze an audience｜khiến khán giả kinh ngạc
tip: Người cảm thấy ngạc nhiên dùng amazed; sự vật gây ngạc nhiên dùng amazing.

senses.zh: người làm ra; nhà sản xuất
senses.en: A person or company that produces something.

ex.en: The furniture maker carved a beautiful chair from oak.
Car makers are investing in cleaner technologies to meet stricter environmental standards and changing consumer expectations.

col: furniture maker｜nhà sản xuất đồ nội thất
tip: Thường đi với tên sản phẩm; người ra quyết định là decision maker.

senses.en: a way to solve a problem or answer a question
a liquid containing a substance dissolved in it

ex.en: Adding another shelf was a simple solution to the clutter.
Investment in renewable energy offers a long-term solution to the environmental problems caused by fossil fuels.

col: a solution to a problem｜giải pháp cho một vấn đề
find a solution｜tìm ra giải pháp
a practical solution｜một giải pháp khả thi
tip: Giải pháp cho ... dùng solution to, không dùng solution of.

senses.en: as a result of what has just been stated

ex.en: The shop was closed; therefore, we went home empty-handed.
Public parks encourage physical activity and social interaction; therefore, cities should invest in maintaining accessible green spaces.

tip: Là trạng từ, không thể chỉ dùng dấu phẩy để nối hai câu hoàn chỉnh.

senses.zh: thói quen; lịch trình thường ngày
senses.en: A regular way of doing things in a particular order.
Done regularly as part of the usual process.

senses.zh: một chuỗi động tác biểu diễn
senses.en: A planned sequence of movements in a performance.

ex.en: A short walk is part of my morning routine.
Maintaining a regular sleep routine can improve concentration and help students cope with academic pressure.

col: daily routine｜lịch sinh hoạt hằng ngày
establish a routine｜thiết lập thói quen cố định
tip: Danh từ chỉ trình tự cố định; tính từ chỉ việc làm theo lệ thường.

senses.en: to say something is true, often without providing proof
to ask for or take something you believe is yours

senses.zh: lời khẳng định; yêu cầu bồi thường
senses.en: a statement of truth or a request for something owed

ex.en: He claims he can fix my bike by lunchtime.
Some researchers claim that access to green spaces can improve mental health and strengthen community relationships.

col: claim responsibility for｜nhận trách nhiệm về
make a claim｜đưa ra khẳng định hoặc yêu cầu bồi thường
tip: claim nhấn mạnh lời nói của ai đó, không có nghĩa là đã được chứng minh.

senses.en: Belief in your abilities or in a successful outcome.
Trust that someone or something is reliable.

ex.en: Practising with friends gave me confidence before the interview.
Supportive feedback can build students' confidence and encourage them to participate more actively in classroom discussions.

col: build confidence｜xây dựng sự tự tin
tip: Tin tưởng vào ai hoặc điều gì dùng confidence in.

senses.en: someone who freely offers to help, usually without payment
to freely offer to do something or give information

ex.en: A volunteer helped us carry the boxes upstairs.
Universities can encourage students to volunteer in their communities by offering flexible schedules and practical support.

col: volunteer to help｜xung phong giúp đỡ
volunteer for a charity｜làm tình nguyện cho tổ chức từ thiện
tip: Tình nguyện làm gì dùng volunteer to do; voluntary là tính từ thường gặp.

senses.en: A device used to turn equipment on or off.
To change from one thing to another.

senses.zh: sự chuyển đổi; sự thay đổi
senses.en: A change from one thing to another.

ex.en: The light switch is just behind the kitchen door.
Governments can encourage households to switch to renewable energy by offering financial support.

tip: switch on/off là bật/tắt thiết bị; switch to nghĩa là chuyển sang.

senses.en: A solid piece of material with fairly flat sides.
To stop movement or prevent something from happening.
An area between streets, or a large building.

ex.en: The sculptor carved a bird from a block of wood.
Poorly parked vehicles can block access to public buildings, creating difficulties for wheelchair users.

col: a block of flats｜một tòa chung cư
a block of ice｜một tảng băng
city block｜dãy nhà trong thành phố
tip: a block of flats là tòa chung cư, một cách nói phổ biến trong tiếng Anh Anh.

senses.en: Not severe or strong in effect
Pleasantly warm rather than cold
Not strong or spicy in flavour

ex.en: I have a mild headache, so I'll rest briefly.
Even mild air pollution can affect vulnerable groups, making regular monitoring essential in densely populated cities.

tip: mild có thể tả triệu chứng, thời tiết và hương vị; không có nghĩa là “vô hại”.

senses.en: An inexpensive place to stay, often with shared rooms.
A place providing temporary accommodation for people needing support.

ex.en: We shared a room with other travellers at the hostel.
Youth hostels make international travel more affordable for students while encouraging interaction between people from different backgrounds.

col: stay in a hostel｜ở nhà trọ
tip: hostel thường có phòng nhiều giường; hotel thường có phòng riêng.

senses.en: a unit of length equal to 2.54 centimetres
to move very slowly over a short distance

ex.en: The shelf is an inch wider than the cupboard.
During rush hour, buses inch through crowded streets, making public transport less attractive to commuters.

col: inch forward｜nhích dần về phía trước
tip: Ký hiệu inch là ″; khi là động từ nghĩa là nhích đi từng chút.

senses.zh: chị/em dâu; chị/em chồng; chị/em vợ
senses.en: your spouse's sister, or your sibling's or spouse's sibling's wife

ex.en: My sister-in-law brought homemade soup when I was ill.
Sharing childcare with a sister-in-law can help working parents balance professional responsibilities and family life.

col: my sister-in-law's family｜gia đình chị/em dâu của tôi
tip: Chỉ chị em thuộc quan hệ thông gia, không phải chị em kế; số nhiều là sisters-in-law.

senses.en: a thick, strong cord made from twisted fibres
to tie or secure something with rope

ex.en: We tied the boat to a post with rope.
Climbers should inspect their ropes regularly because damaged equipment can put the entire group at risk.

col: a length of rope｜một đoạn dây thừng
rope off an area｜dùng dây thừng rào lại một khu vực
tip: Chỉ chất liệu chung dùng rope; một sợi dây là a rope.

senses.en: To make liquid flow from a container.
To rain very heavily.
To move or arrive continuously in large quantities.

ex.en: She poured warm milk into a large blue mug.
When factories pour untreated waste into rivers, they threaten aquatic ecosystems and nearby communities' drinking water.

col: pour into｜đổ vào; đổ dồn vào
pour with rain｜mưa như trút nước
pour money into｜đổ nhiều tiền vào
tip: Đổ vào dùng pour into; đổ ra dùng pour out of.

senses.en: Extremely good or enjoyable.

senses.zh: đáng kinh ngạc; đáng nể sợ
senses.en: Causing great admiration, wonder, or sometimes fear.

ex.en: The mountain view from our tent was absolutely awesome.
The awesome power of volcanic eruptions highlights the importance of effective monitoring systems in nearby communities.

col: an awesome experience｜một trải nghiệm tuyệt vời
an awesome view｜cảnh đẹp tuyệt vời
awesome power｜sức mạnh đáng nể sợ
tip: Nghĩa “siêu hay” khá khẩu ngữ; văn viết trang trọng nên chọn từ cụ thể hơn.

senses.en: funny or connected with comedy
a publication telling stories through sequences of pictures
a performer who entertains people by making them laugh

ex.en: His comic dance had everyone laughing at the party.
Comic characters can make educational programmes more engaging and help children remember important information.

col: comic timing｜khả năng bắt nhịp hài
tip: comic liên quan đến hài kịch; comical nhấn mạnh sự buồn cười.

senses.en: Information in something, or the amount of a substance it contains
Happy with what you have or with your situation

senses.zh: làm hài lòng; làm thỏa mãn
senses.en: To make someone satisfied with what is available

ex.en: The content of this podcast always makes me laugh.
Schools should teach students to evaluate online content critically rather than accepting every claim as reliable information.

col: content yourself with｜tự bằng lòng với
tip: Danh từ nhấn âm đầu, tính từ và động từ nhấn âm sau; mục lục dùng contents.

senses.en: a group of twelve
a large unspecified quantity, used in the plural

ex.en: Please buy a dozen eggs on your way home.
Dozens of community gardens have opened across the city, giving residents more opportunities to grow food.

col: half a dozen｜nửa tá; sáu cái
tip: two dozen không thêm s; dozens of nghĩa là rất nhiều.

senses.zh: sự phát triển; sự phát dục
senses.en: the process of growing, changing, or becoming more advanced

senses.zh: sự phát triển (sản phẩm, đất đai); sự nghiên cứu phát triển
senses.en: the process of creating or improving products, land, or services

senses.zh: diễn biến mới; tình hình mới
senses.en: a new event or change in a situation

ex.en: Regular play supports a young child's development in many ways.
Investment in public transport can support economic development while reducing traffic congestion in growing cities.

col: child development｜sự phát triển của trẻ
tip: Phát triển nói chung thường không đếm được; khi nghĩa là “diễn biến mới” thì đếm được.

senses.en: at the present time

ex.en: Our kitchen is currently full of boxes from the move.
Many cities are currently investing in cycling infrastructure to reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.

col: currently under construction｜hiện đang được xây dựng
tip: Nghĩa là “hiện nay”, thường đứng trước động từ thường và sau động từ be.

senses.en: Extremely cold, or cold enough for water to become ice.
The temperature at which water turns into ice.

ex.en: My hands were freezing after waiting outside for the bus.
Freezing temperatures can damage water pipes and disrupt essential services, particularly in areas with ageing infrastructure.

col: freezing temperatures｜nhiệt độ ở điểm đóng băng hoặc thấp hơn
tip: I'm freezing nghĩa là tôi lạnh cóng, không nhất thiết là nước thật sự đóng băng.

senses.zh: sức khỏe thể chất; thể lực
senses.en: The condition of being physically healthy and strong.

senses.zh: sự phù hợp; sự đủ năng lực
senses.en: The quality of being suitable for a task or purpose.

ex.en: Swimming every morning has really improved my fitness.
Schools can improve children's fitness by providing regular opportunities for enjoyable physical activity throughout the week.

col: fitness for work｜năng lực làm việc
tip: Danh từ không đếm được; fitness for chỉ mức độ phù hợp với việc gì.

senses.en: a short account giving the main points of something
presenting only the main facts or points

ex.en: Could you give me a quick summary of the meeting?
A clear summary at the beginning of a report helps readers understand its main findings quickly.

col: a brief summary｜một bản tóm tắt ngắn gọn
a summary of｜bản tóm tắt của
an executive summary｜bản tóm tắt điều hành
tip: a summary of theo sau là đối tượng được tóm tắt; in summary dùng để kết luận.

senses.en: A sculpture representing a person or animal.

ex.en: A bronze statue of a horse stands beside the fountain.
Public statues can preserve local history, but communities should discuss which figures deserve such recognition.

col: a marble statue｜tượng đá cẩm thạch
tip: statue là bức tượng; status là địa vị, chú ý phân biệt chính tả.

senses.zh: thuộc chính trị; thuộc đảng phái
senses.en: relating to government, public power, or political parties

ex.en: We often discuss political issues around the dinner table.
Political stability can encourage long-term investment and help governments maintain essential public services.

col: political stability｜sự ổn định chính trị
tip: political là tính từ; politics là chính trị, politician là chính trị gia.

senses.en: a vegetable with large leaves forming a firm round head

ex.en: She sliced the cabbage thinly and added it to soup.
Locally grown vegetables such as cabbage can support healthier diets while reducing the environmental impact of food transport.

col: a head of cabbage｜một bắp cải
tip: Cả bắp là a cabbage (đếm được); khi là nguyên liệu nấu ăn thường không đếm được.

senses.en: Not costing much money.

ex.en: We found an inexpensive café near the train station.
Cycling offers an inexpensive alternative to driving and can help reduce traffic congestion in growing cities.

col: inexpensive alternative｜lựa chọn thay thế rẻ
tip: Trung tính hơn cheap, thường không ngụ ý chất lượng kém.

senses.en: a movable covering for part of a floor
a thick blanket used for warmth

ex.en: The cat curled up on the rug beside the sofa.
Placing a rug on a hard floor can reduce noise and make shared housing more comfortable.

col: a hearth rug｜thảm trước lò sưởi
tip: rug thường chỉ phủ một phần sàn; carpet có thể trải kín cả phòng.

senses.en: A person or business acting on behalf of others
Someone secretly gathering information for a government or organisation
A substance or force that produces a particular effect

ex.en: The travel agent found us a cheaper flight home.
Local community groups can act as agents of change by encouraging residents to adopt more sustainable habits.

col: estate agent｜người môi giới bất động sản
an agent of change｜tác nhân thay đổi
tip: agent không chỉ là điệp viên; trong cleaning agent, agent nghĩa là “chất”.

senses.en: A place where ships load, unload, or shelter.
A physical connection point or virtual channel for computer communication.
The left side of a ship or aircraft, facing forward.

ex.en: We watched fishing boats returning to the port.
Expanding the port could increase international trade, but it may also damage nearby marine habitats.

col: a busy port｜một cảng tấp nập
tip: Khi chỉ mạn trái, từ trái nghĩa là starboard (mạn phải).

senses.en: A place where people do their jobs.

ex.en: Our workplace has a quiet room for lunch breaks.
Creating an inclusive workplace helps employees feel valued and encourages cooperation among people from different backgrounds.

col: workplace safety｜an toàn nơi làm việc
in the workplace｜ở nơi làm việc
tip: Chỉ chung văn phòng, nhà máy, v.v.; không chỉ riêng văn phòng.

senses.zh: thông minh; có khả năng hiểu tốt
senses.en: Able to learn, understand, and think well.
Able to process information and respond automatically in useful ways.

ex.en: Our intelligent puppy quickly learned how to open doors.
Intelligent transport systems can reduce congestion by adjusting traffic signals in response to changing road conditions.

tip: intelligent là thông minh; intelligible là dễ hiểu.

senses.en: paid work or the state of having a paid job

senses.zh: sự sử dụng; sự vận dụng
senses.en: the use of something for a particular purpose

ex.en: She found employment at a bakery near her home.
Investment in renewable energy can create employment opportunities while helping countries meet their climate targets.

col: full-time employment｜việc làm toàn thời gian
tip: Thường không đếm được; một công việc dùng a job, không dùng an employment.

senses.en: An imaginary line around Earth's middle, equally distant from both poles.

ex.en: Our guide explained why it stays warm near the equator.
Regions near the equator receive intense sunlight throughout the year, contributing to consistently high temperatures.

col: cross the equator｜băng qua xích đạo
north of the equator｜phía bắc xích đạo
tip: Thường có the trước equator; tính từ là equatorial.

senses.en: A cream that protects skin from the sun's harmful rays.

ex.en: I packed suncream and a hat for our afternoon walk.
Schools can encourage children to use suncream and seek shade during outdoor activities in sunny weather.

col: put on suncream｜thoa kem chống nắng
a tube of suncream｜một tuýp kem chống nắng
high-factor suncream｜kem chống nắng chỉ số cao
tip: Chủ yếu dùng trong tiếng Anh Anh; cũng thường viết là sun cream.

senses.en: bearing someone's signature as proof of agreement or authorship
wrote a signature to identify oneself or show agreement

ex.en: I put the signed form in a blue envelope.
A signed agreement helps protect both tenants and landlords by clearly defining their rights and responsibilities.

col: a signed contract｜hợp đồng đã ký
a signed copy｜bản có chữ ký
a signed agreement｜thỏa thuận đã ký
tip: signed có thể là tính từ; “được ký bởi ai” dùng signed by.

senses.zh: chống thấm nước; không thấm nước
senses.en: not allowing water to pass through
to treat something so water cannot pass through it

ex.en: My waterproof jacket kept me dry during the storm.
Outdoor workers need waterproof clothing to remain comfortable and protected when carrying out tasks in wet weather.

col: a waterproof jacket｜áo khoác chống nước
waterproof a roof｜chống thấm cho mái nhà
tip: water-resistant chỉ có khả năng chịu nước ở mức nhất định, kém hơn waterproof.

senses.en: Having a condition that limits activities or participation in society.

ex.en: The pool has a lift for disabled swimmers.
Universities should provide accessible facilities and appropriate support to ensure that disabled students can participate fully in campus life.

col: disabled access｜lối đi cho người khuyết tật
disabled parking space｜chỗ đỗ xe dành cho người khuyết tật
tip: Có thể nói disabled people hoặc people with disabilities, tùy theo mong muốn của người đó.

senses.en: to provide something that someone needs
the provision or available amount of something needed
essential items kept or provided for use

ex.en: A nearby farm supplies fresh eggs to our shop.
Cities must secure a reliable water supply as population growth and climate change place increasing pressure on resources.

col: supply someone with something｜cung cấp cho ai thứ gì
tip: supply A with B = supply B to A; vật tư thường dùng supplies.

senses.en: involving all the usual working or studying hours
for all the usual working or studying hours

ex.en: My sister starts her first full-time job next week.
Affordable childcare enables more parents to return to full-time employment without placing excessive pressure on family finances.

col: full-time employment｜việc làm toàn thời gian
a full-time student｜sinh viên chính quy
work full-time｜làm việc toàn thời gian
tip: Khi bổ nghĩa cho danh từ thì giữ dấu gạch nối, như a full-time job.

senses.en: to calculate a total by adding equal amounts repeatedly
to increase greatly in quantity, or produce more living organisms

ex.en: Multiply the price by three to find the total.
Bacteria can multiply rapidly in warm conditions, making proper food storage essential for public health.

col: multiply rapidly｜tăng nhanh; sinh sôi nhanh chóng
tip: A nhân B nói multiply A by B; quá khứ là multiplied.

senses.en: an act of asking politely or formally for something
to ask politely or formally for something

ex.en: The hotel agreed to my request for extra pillows.
Residents can request detailed information about proposed developments before local authorities make their final planning decisions.

col: make a request｜đưa ra yêu cầu
a request for information｜yêu cầu cung cấp thông tin
tip: Danh từ đi với for; động từ đi thẳng với tân ngữ: request information.

senses.en: to process used materials so they can be used again

ex.en: We recycle glass bottles at the centre near our house.
Cities can reduce landfill waste by making it easier for residents to recycle everyday packaging.

col: recycle household waste｜tái chế rác sinh hoạt
recycle plastic bottles｜tái chế chai nhựa
tip: recycle là xử lý để dùng lại; reuse nhấn mạnh việc dùng lại trực tiếp.

senses.en: a formal meeting to discuss a particular subject

ex.en: Our hotel is hosting a conference for local teachers.
At the international conference, researchers discussed how cities could reduce air pollution without limiting economic growth.

col: attend a conference｜tham dự hội nghị
hold a conference｜tổ chức hội nghị
tip: Chỉ cuộc họp chính thức; tham dự hội nghị dùng attend a conference.

senses.en: To cook food using dry heat, especially in an oven.
Cooked using dry heat in an oven or over a fire.
A large piece of roasted meat, or a meal containing it.

ex.en: We usually roast potatoes with garlic and fresh herbs.
Families can roast seasonal vegetables at home to prepare nutritious meals without relying on highly processed foods.

col: a Sunday roast｜bữa thịt nướng ngày Chủ nhật
tip: roast thường dùng cho thịt và rau củ; bánh mì và bánh ngọt thường dùng bake.

senses.zh: anh hùng; người được ngưỡng mộ
senses.en: someone admired for courage, achievements, or good actions

senses.zh: nam chính; nhân vật nam chính
senses.en: the main male character in a story

ex.en: The firefighter became a local hero after the rescue.
Films often portray the hero as an exceptional individual, although real social progress usually requires collective effort.

col: action hero｜nam chính phim hành động
tip: Số nhiều là heroes; hero trong truyện không nhất thiết có phẩm chất cao đẹp.

senses.en: To cut with repeated sharp blows using a blade
A sharp downward blow with a blade or hand
A piece of meat cut with a bone attached

ex.en: Please chop the carrots while I heat the soup.
When communities chop down trees for fuel, they may unintentionally damage habitats and increase soil erosion.

tip: Quá khứ chopped, tiếp diễn chopping, đều gấp đôi chữ p.

senses.en: A small bitter fruit used for oil, or its tree
Yellowish green in colour, or describing light brown skin

ex.en: She added a few olives to the fresh salad.
Olive cultivation supports rural livelihoods in dry regions, although prolonged drought can significantly reduce harvests.

col: olive skin｜làn da màu nâu nhạt
tip: olive có thể chỉ quả, cây hoặc màu sắc; olive oil thường không đếm được.

senses.en: The feeling of being unhappy, especially after loss or disappointment.

ex.en: She felt a deep sadness when her friend moved away.
Regular social contact can help reduce feelings of sadness among older people who live alone.

col: a sense of sadness｜cảm giác buồn
overcome with sadness｜đau buồn khôn xiết
tip: Thường là danh từ không đếm được; a sense of sadness nghĩa là một cảm giác buồn.

senses.en: A car with a driver whom you pay for transport.
The enclosed part of a vehicle where the driver sits.

ex.en: We shared a cab home after the concert.
Affordable night buses could reduce reliance on cabs among workers whose shifts end after midnight.

col: a truck cab｜buồng lái xe tải
tip: Với nghĩa xe taxi thì đồng nghĩa với taxi; cũng có thể chỉ buồng lái của xe tải, v.v.

senses.en: one of the main sections of a book

senses.zh: giai đoạn quan trọng (đời người, lịch sử)
senses.en: a distinct period in someone's life or in history

senses.zh: chi nhánh địa phương của một tổ chức
senses.en: a local branch of a larger organisation

ex.en: I read one chapter before turning off the light.
The final chapter examines how public transport investment can reduce inequality in rapidly growing cities.

col: a chapter in history｜một giai đoạn trong lịch sử
a local chapter｜chi nhánh địa phương
tip: Một chương sách dùng chapter; phần nhỏ hơn trong chương thường là section.

senses.zh: cập nhật; thông báo tin mới
senses.en: to make something current or give someone the latest information

senses.zh: tin mới nhất; bản cập nhật
senses.en: new information or a change that makes something more current

ex.en: Please update your address before we send the parcel.
Governments should regularly update environmental regulations to reflect scientific discoveries and respond to emerging risks.

col: update someone on something｜cập nhật tình hình cho ai về việc gì
a software update｜bản cập nhật phần mềm
tip: Động từ nhấn âm sau; danh từ nhấn âm đầu, đọc là /ˈʌpdeɪt/.

senses.en: To give all your attention to a particular task.
To bring things together in one place or direct efforts there.
A substance made stronger by removing water or other material.

ex.en: I cannot concentrate with the television playing so loudly.
Governments should concentrate resources on preventive healthcare to reduce pressure on hospitals in the long term.

col: concentrate on a task｜tập trung vào một nhiệm vụ
concentrate resources on｜dồn nguồn lực vào
fruit juice concentrate｜nước ép trái cây cô đặc
tip: concentrate on theo sau là danh từ hoặc danh động từ, nghĩa là tập trung vào.

senses.en: Extremely beautiful or attractive.
Very pleasant or enjoyable.

ex.en: The garden looks gorgeous in the early morning sunshine.
Although coastal destinations offer gorgeous scenery, uncontrolled tourism can damage the natural environments that attract visitors.

tip: Mạnh hơn beautiful, thường dùng để khen trong khẩu ngữ.

senses.en: To look at someone or something very briefly.
A quick, brief look at someone or something.

ex.en: She glanced out of the window before opening the door.
Commuters often glance at their phones while walking, which can reduce their awareness of nearby traffic.

col: take a glance｜nhìn qua một chút
tip: glance at là liếc nhanh; stare at là nhìn chằm chằm.

senses.en: To make someone feel awkward, ashamed, or uncomfortable.

ex.en: Please don't embarrass me by sharing that childhood photo.
Correcting every mistake publicly can embarrass language learners and discourage them from participating in classroom discussions.

col: an embarrassing moment｜một khoảnh khắc khó xử
tip: Người cảm thấy ngượng dùng embarrassed; sự việc gây ngượng dùng embarrassing.

senses.en: a long, hollow object that carries liquids or gases
a soft container squeezed to release paste or cream
the underground railway system in London

ex.en: Water flowed through a clear tube into the tank.
Taking the tube instead of driving can help commuters avoid congestion in central London.

col: a tube of toothpaste｜một tuýp kem đánh răng
take the tube｜đi tàu điện ngầm Luân Đôn
tip: the tube chỉ riêng tàu điện ngầm Luân Đôn; một tuýp kem đánh răng dùng a tube of.

senses.zh: xe cộ; phương tiện giao thông
senses.en: A machine used to transport people or goods.
Something used to communicate ideas or achieve a purpose.

ex.en: We left our vehicle outside the small mountain hotel.
Electric vehicles can reduce urban air pollution, especially when their electricity comes from renewable sources.

col: a vehicle for change｜công cụ thúc đẩy thay đổi
tip: Khi chỉ phương tiện giao thông thì đếm được, không chỉ riêng ô tô.

senses.zh: thuộc môi trường tự nhiên; thân thiện với môi trường
senses.en: relating to nature or efforts to protect it
relating to the surroundings in which people or organisms live

ex.en: Our school organised an environmental project to clean the river.
Governments should consider the environmental impact of new roads before approving major construction projects.

col: environmental factors｜các yếu tố môi trường
environmental damage｜sự tàn phá môi trường
tip: environmental là tính từ; bản thân “môi trường” là environment.

senses.en: A sea animal with a central body and usually five arms.

ex.en: We spotted an orange starfish in a shallow rock pool.
Changes in ocean temperature can affect starfish populations and disrupt the balance of coastal ecosystems.

col: a rock pool starfish｜sao biển ở vũng đá
a starfish arm｜một nhánh của sao biển
tip: Số ít và số nhiều thường giống nhau; sao biển là động vật không xương sống, không phải loài cá.

senses.zh: khó tin; không thể tin được
senses.en: So surprising that it is difficult to believe
Extremely good, impressive, or great in amount

ex.en: It seems incredible that this tiny seed becomes a tree.
Advances in medical technology have brought incredible improvements in the quality of life for many patients.

col: an incredible achievement｜một thành tựu đáng kinh ngạc
an incredible amount｜một lượng rất lớn
tip: incredible có thể nghĩa là khó tin, cũng dùng trong khẩu ngữ để khen “tuyệt vời”.

senses.en: Equipment with steps for climbing up or down

senses.zh: nấc thang thăng tiến; hệ thống thứ bậc
senses.en: A series of levels through which someone can progress

ex.en: She climbed the ladder to pick apples from the tree.
Access to professional training can help young employees move up the career ladder more quickly.

tip: ladder là thang di động; stairs là cầu thang trong tòa nhà.

senses.zh: trách nhiệm; sự chịu trách nhiệm
senses.en: The duty to manage something or answer for its results.
A task or duty that you are expected to handle.

ex.en: Feeding the dog is your responsibility this weekend.
Governments and businesses share responsibility for reducing waste, but individuals also have an important role to play.

col: take responsibility for｜chịu trách nhiệm về
a sense of responsibility｜tinh thần trách nhiệm
share responsibility｜cùng chia sẻ trách nhiệm
tip: Trách nhiệm nói chung thường không đếm được; nhiệm vụ cụ thể thì đếm được; thường đi với for.

senses.en: Someone trained to install and repair electrical systems.

ex.en: The electrician fixed the broken light in our kitchen.
Training more qualified electricians is essential as households increasingly adopt solar panels and electric vehicle charging equipment.

col: qualified electrician｜thợ điện có chứng chỉ
tip: electrician là thợ điện; kỹ sư điện là electrical engineer.

senses.en: the place someone or something is travelling to

ex.en: We finally reached our destination just before sunset.
Popular tourist destinations must balance economic benefits with the need to protect local communities and natural environments.

col: reach your destination｜đến nơi cần đến
tip: reach a destination không thêm to; arrive at đi với điểm đến.

senses.en: Having a smooth surface that reflects light.

ex.en: She polished her shoes until they looked shiny.
Shiny packaging may attract consumers, but it often creates waste that is difficult to recycle.

tip: Chỉ bề mặt phản chiếu ánh sáng, không có nghĩa là bản thân vật phát sáng.

senses.en: Much larger than usual
An imaginary person of enormous size

senses.zh: tập đoàn lớn; nhân vật kiệt xuất
senses.en: A very large company or an exceptionally important person

ex.en: A giant pumpkin filled almost the entire garden cart.
Technology giants have considerable influence over how people access information and communicate with one another.

col: a giant leap｜một bước nhảy vọt
a giant screen｜màn hình khổng lồ
a technology giant｜ông lớn ngành công nghệ
tip: Khi là tính từ thường đứng trước danh từ; khi là danh từ có thể chỉ “ông lớn” của một ngành.

senses.en: a single part or quantity within a larger whole
a device or separate part of a machine

senses.zh: phòng ban; tổ; đơn vị quân đội
senses.en: a group organised for a particular task

ex.en: We finished the first unit before our lunch break.
Each unit of the course introduces practical skills that students can apply in the workplace.

col: a unit of measurement｜đơn vị đo lường
a family unit｜đơn vị gia đình
an air-conditioning unit｜thiết bị điều hòa
an intensive care unit｜khoa chăm sóc đặc biệt
tip: Đơn vị đo lường thường dùng a unit of, theo sau là thứ được đo.
